claim: Madeleine Albright came to the United States as a refugee when she was 11 years old.

evidence.quote: Email from Madeleine Albright: When I Was Welcomed as a Refugee
I came to the United States as a refugee when I was 11 years old.
Dr. Albright was born in Prague, immigrated to the United States at the age of 11, and became a U.S. citizen in 1957.
Having arrived here as a refugee at age 11, she never forgot the generosity that America extended to her family when they needed it most.

notes: First-person text attributed to Albright, sent to the White House email list (blog post of September 20, 2016). Merge albright-2026-10-09: combined duplicate candidates tmp-institutional-F-60, tmp-institutional-F-71 (their supporting quotes copied verbatim into evidence).
